description: NaO₈I₃ crystallizes in the tetragonal P̅4 space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are four shorter (2.41 Å) and four longer (2.68 Å) Na-O bond lengths. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a tetrahedral geometry to four equivalent O atoms. All Na-O bond lengths are 2.31 Å. There are four inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na and two equivalent I atoms. There is one shorter (1.79 Å) and one longer (2.61 Å) O-I bond length. In the second O site, O is bonded in a bent 120 degrees geometry to one Na and one I atom. The O-I bond length is 1.80 Å. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 1-coordinate geometry to one I atom. The O-I bond length is 1.82 Å. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to one Na and two I atoms. There is one shorter (1.94 Å) and one longer (2.04 Å) O-I bond length. There are two inequivalent I sites. In the first I site, I is bonded in a see-saw-like geometry to four O atoms. In the second I site, I is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to four O atoms.
